nodes.label: X25519 Raw 32-byte Key Format
nodes.rationale: Android KeyPair.public.encoded returns 44-byte X509 format; must extract last 32 bytes. Using URL-safe base64 because Android Uri.getQueryParameter() URL-decodes '+' as space.
